text.tspan: A relational map of the High Line confrontation.
The street names it after the
Paints it; his knuckle is cut.
Catches the tin and contests removal.
The keeper is told to submit an invoice.
B > C: indicates where to paint / C > A: paints / D > A: orders removal / E > D: contests this application / C > D: pours paint over / A > F: aftermath reclassified
Sava's stamp is on an order he contests. That does not identify who issued it or establish one institutional intention.
